workflow.name: ERC-7540 Asynchronous Vault Conformance Review
workflow.description: A production-focused workflow that maps each active asynchronous ERC-4626 vault, performs parallel normative ERC-7540 conformance reviews, and adjudicates candidate deviations into evidence-backed findings while excluding generic vault economics and implementation choices permitted by the standard.
